en.CloudShellSubtitle: Run Kloudust commands directly — the same verbs the console uses behind every button
en.CloudShellScopePost: Switch the project in the top bar before running anything that creates resources. Everything you run is recorded in the alerts panel.
en.CloudShellParseIdle: Type a command, or insert one from the reference on the right.
en.CloudShellNoOutputMessage: Run a command and its output appears here, and in the alerts panel.
en.CloudShellInsertFoot: Insert drops the syntax into the box — replace the parts in quotes. Trailing optional arguments can be left off.
en.CloudShellNoVerbMatch: No command in the reference matches that search.
en.CloudShellNoHistory: Commands you run appear here, newest first.
en.CloudShellUnknownVerb: is not in the reference. It will still be sent to the server as typed.
en.CloudShellConfirmAck: I have checked the target name and understand this cannot be undone

commands.description: Create a virtual machine from an image. Trailing arguments are optional.
Power operation on a VM: start, stop, restart or pause.
Change cores, memory or disks on an existing VM.
Copy a VM into one or more new machines.
Live-migrate a running VM to another host.
Export a VM image to an SFTP destination.
Destroy a VM together with its disks and snapshots.
commands.danger: permanently deletes the virtual machine, its disks and all of its snapshots.

commands.description: List the VMs of an org or project.
Attach a physical KVM host to the cloud (15 arguments — see documentation).
List the hosts registered in this cloud.
Register an OS image and download it into the catalogue.
List the OS images available for VM creation.
Remove an image from the catalogue.
commands.danger: removes the image. Running VMs are unaffected, but new ones can no longer use it.

commands.description: Create an isolated virtual network.
List the virtual networks in this project.
Delete a virtual network.
commands.danger: deletes the virtual network. Machines attached to it lose connectivity.

commands.description: Attach a VM to a virtual network.
Create or update a firewall ruleset. Settings are a JSON rule array.
Attach a firewall ruleset to a VM on a network.
List the firewall rulesets in this project.
Delete a firewall ruleset.
commands.danger: deletes the ruleset. VMs using it fall back to having no rules applied.

commands.description: Create or update a router. Settings are a JSON vnet/IP array.
List the routers in this project.
Delete a router.
commands.danger: deletes the router and the routes it provides between networks.

commands.description: Assign a routable IP address to a VM.
Register an IP address against a host.
List the snapshots in this project.
Take a snapshot of a VM's disks.
Roll a VM back to a snapshot.
Delete a snapshot.
commands.danger: permanently deletes the snapshot. The VM cannot be rolled back to it afterwards.

commands.description: List the projects the signed-in user can access.
Create a project in this organization.
Give a user access to a project.
Remove a user's access to a project.
Delete a project.
commands.danger: deletes the project. Everything still inside it becomes unreachable.
